data: NVIDIA's GAAP operating income was about $4.22 billion in fiscal 2023 (the year ended January 29, 2023) and about $81.45 billion in fiscal 2025 (the year ended January 26, 2025). That is an increase of roughly $77.23 billion, or about 1,828%, which is nearly nineteen times the fiscal 2023 level. The fiscal 2023 figure was depressed by a large inventory charge and the surge in data-center spending that followed the AI boom. These figures are from my training data, so please verify them against NVIDIA's 10-K filings before relying on them.
